name: overflow
description: Below 10% Codex allowance, delegate work to friends running visible Overflow earning tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Keep working when Codex is nearly out.
interface.longDescription: Overflow checks your main Codex allowance when a session starts. Below 10% it makes the session coordinate and delegate instead of exhausting itself. A friend opens a visible task and runs /earn; that task claims the order, renames itself, performs the work on screen, and returns the artifact to the original conversation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use /work to delegate from this task, or /earn to take one queued Overflow task visibly.
